nearDuplicatePairReview.reason: Both items forecast dry solids production as BOD removed multiplied by a given solids yield of 0.65, differing only in the BOD removed value. Same formula and scenario, so the second item was replaced.
nearDuplicatePairReview.oldStem: A plant removes 480 kg/day of BOD. Use a given solids yield of 0.65 kg of solids per kg of BOD removed to forecast solids production. What is the forecast solids production? Round to 1 decimal place.
